title: Instructions about R packages
text: getAnywhere("<funcname>") returns .Internal .Primitive, function internal primitive. source code functions can viewed code repositories, computer installed R source using Rtools (see section ‘Rtools’ vignette Installing R, Rtools RStudio: vignette("install_r", package = "checkrpkgs")). Locate file src/main/names.c look first column name R function find appropriate c-entry given second column file. either search c-entry using GitHub search, manually locate c-file (name file c-entry without prefix do_) src/main get file source code. example, getAnywhere("matrix") shows, among others, line .Internal(matrix(data, nrow, ncol, byrow, dimnames, missing(nrow), missing(ncol))). file src/main/names.c entry matrix first column: {"matrix", do_matrix,  0,  11, 7,  {PP_FUNCALL, PREC_FN,   0}} Searching src/main matrix gives file array.c one results. file contains source code matrix. Similarly, getAnywhere("log10") shows function (x)  .Primitive("log10"). file src/main/names.c entry log10 first column: {"log10",  do_log1arg, 10, 1,  1,  {PP_FUNCALL, PREC_FN,   0}}. Searching src/main log1arg gives file arithmetic.c one results. file contains source code log10. Sometimes R-function defined file defines multiple functions thus general name. file c-code similar general name. example, source code make.names() defined src/library/base/R/character.R contains (among others) code .Internal(make.names(names, allow_)), c-code do_makenames() file src/main/character.c.
